name: Dayforce HR Service Delivery
summary: Dayforce HR Service Delivery is the HR case management and knowledge module in Dayforce, formerly Ceridian. Employees create an HR case in the mobile app, see it under My Cases with a case number, and can use HR Knowledge Management for policy answers. The product page shows no prices and offers Get a demo and Contact Sales.

facts.text: The mobile app guide for release R2026.2.1 says employees choose a topic, add a subject and description, optionally attach files, and submit an HR case.
The same guide says employees see their submitted case with its details and a system-assigned case number, and find it under My Cases.
The HR Service Delivery page says HR Knowledge Management allows organizations to store information and policies for easy, yet secure, access.

The HR Service Delivery page says case creation 'will be available' for when employees need personal help from HR. The newer help guide shows employees creating cases now, so confirm the release before buying.

plans.name: HR Service Delivery
plans.notes: The product page has a Ready to get started section with Get a demo and Contact Sales buttons. No prices are shown.

hiddenCosts: The page we read gives no prices, minimums or module fees.
